newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ex-premier Rocard to leave French parliament.
newsitem.headline: Ex-premier Rocard to leave French parliament.

text.p: Socialist ex-prime minister Michel Rocard said on Sunday he would renounce his seat in the French Senate (upper house) to keep his seat in the European Parliament, observing a party rule against holding several elected mandates.

He said he would leave the Senate after it ends debating a controversial bill on immigration. The bill could return to the Senate after a second reading in the National Assembly (lower house) beginning on Tuesday.

Rocard, 66, whose presidential ambitions were thwarted by the late fellow Socialist president Francois Mitterrand, was prime minister in 1988-91. He briefly headed the Socialist Party after its humiliating election rout in 1993.
